algorithms.description: Select from configured candidate order and weights.
Select uniformly from the eligible candidate models.
Score quality, latency, cost, and load under optional SLOs.
Ask a System One model which declared candidate should answer.
Call the candidates in order until one answer is accepted.
Run a parallel panel and synthesize a judged final response.
Run multi-round parallel reasoning and synthesis.
Execute a bounded candidate set and return comparable choices.
Execute a static or dynamically planned Router Flow.

plugins.description: Reuse exact or semantically compatible responses.
Retrieve documents and memories, compress the request within a budget and inject the context.
Insert or replace the system prompt.
Add, update, or remove provider-bound headers the Router does not own.
Block or annotate answers on the signals they are checked with.
Capture bounded request and response replay evidence.
Return a fixed response without calling an upstream model.
Allow, block or remove the request's tools, then let the decision model filter or add the tools it needs.
Constrain or remove provider request parameters.
Add bounded Anthropic prompt-cache markers after route selection.
Send a bounded asynchronous copy to a secondary model.
Replace the personal data a pii rule finds in the provider-bound request with placeholders.
